source_record.title: 큰 복셀 연꽃의 작은 투명 연못
source_record.description: A charming voxel art lotus flower sits at the center of this miniature diorama scene, its blush pink and cream cube-shaped petals layered gently around a glowing golden blocky center. Below it, a calm pond made of stepped glassy blue cubes stretches outward, dotted with oversized pixel-like lily pads in emerald and teal tones. Tiny cube dewdrops rest on the surface, while a small voxel koi fish peeks out just below the water. The soft pastel pink background and gentle studio lighting give the whole piece a warm, cozy feel, making it look like a tiny 3D world you could hold in your hand. With crisp geometric edges and an isometric-style layout, this cute rendering blends nature with playful digital block art.

source_record.description: A charming 3D stylized bunny with soft cream-colored fur stands eagerly on its hind legs, reaching upward with hopeful anticipation. Its exaggerated ears and expressive eyes convey excitement as it stretches toward a simplified human hand offering a bright orange carrot. Set against a smooth gradient background, this clean, minimal design focuses entirely on the sweet moment of connection between giver and receiver. The bunny's fluffy texture contrasts beautifully with the vibrant carrot, creating a heartwarming scene that captures a pure moment of joy and anticipation. The vertical composition draws the eye upward, emphasizing the rabbit's yearning gesture and the gentle act of feeding.

source_record.title: 작은 보라 후드 인형과 분홍 원형 받침
source_record.description: A charming chibi-style anime character brings joy with her adorable super-deformed proportions and sweet personality. The tiny figure stands gracefully on a soft pink pedestal, wearing a beautiful flowing lavender outfit decorated with delicate ribbon accents. Her most captivating feature is her oversized sparkling eyes with heart-shaped highlights that gaze gently outward, complemented by rosy blushing cheeks. One small hand rests confidently on her hip while the other playfully touches her cheek in an endearing gesture. The dreamy background features a smooth gradient blending cream and baby blue tones, decorated with floating sparkles and tiny star motifs. Soft golden rim lighting highlights the smooth rounded forms and cute proportions. source_record.title: 작은 카드와 깃발의 둥근 마을 안내자
source_record.description: A smiling clay man stands proudly in the center of a charming miniature town square, holding a small blue and white flag in one hand and an ID card in the other. His soft, rounded body and friendly expression give him a warm, welcoming feel typical of claymation-style art. Around him, chunky pastel buildings in terracotta, mint green, and cream colors create a cozy neighborhood backdrop, complete with a tiny white bench, a lamppost, and a small fountain. The soft studio lighting and shallow depth of field add a dreamy, tactile quality to the scene, making it feel like a handcrafted stop-motion set. This playful 3D illustration combines a cheerful civic theme with a soft, rounded art style perfect for storytelling or animation projects.

source_record.title: 작은 모니터와 조명이 있는 보라 입체 방
source_record.description: A charming isometric 3D diorama showcases a cozy bedroom filled with soft pastel colors like lavender, lilac, and pink. A stylized young woman with long glossy purple twintails stands beside a lavender bed, adding a lively touch to the miniature scene. The room features a small desk with a tiny monitor and plush toys, along with hanging fairy lights that create a warm, magical glow. A small balcony area holds violet flower pots, adding greenery to the space. The medical professional stands in a bright, inviting clinic built entirely from chunky cubic blocks in soft pastel colors including mint green, baby blue, peach, and coral accents. The whimsical scene includes geometric furniture, adorable potted plants made of blocky foliage, and floating heart-shaped health icons that add a playful touch. A tiny clipboard rests in the doctor's hand while miniature voxel medicine bottles hover nearby. The toy-like medical office features gentle studio lighting with a dreamy gradient background in lavender and cream tones, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes healthcare feel approachable and fun. The isometric perspective and soft shadows between each block give the scene delightful depth and dimension.
